einzeiler: Can you remain best friends with your ex? Chris and Alice share their story.
kurzfassung: Chris Princess and Alice Hampton were married, divorced, and are now best friends who talk every day. They discuss how they met on Bumble, the challenges of IVF, and why mutual respect kept their split completely amicable. Today, they remain closely involved in each other's lives, sharing holidays and supporting one another.
stichpunkte: Chris and Alice met on Bumble over a decade ago and married within 18 months.
Alice built a successful talent management company representing top creators and brands.
The couple went through seven rounds of IVF and lost two boys, which took a heavy emotional toll.
Disagreements over where to live—Santa Barbara versus Chicago—ultimately led to their separation.
Their divorce was entirely amicable, costing only four hundred dollars in legal fees.
They maintain a close friendship, share holidays, and even talk about their dating lives.
Both emphasize that choosing to avoid drama and holding onto mutual respect made their unique post-divorce relationship possible.

beschreibung:
Bill and Giuliana sit down with their close friends Alice and Chris, who went from being married to getting divorced and now they are currently best friends. They share the secrets to staying friends with an ex, how they avoided the usual post-divorce drama and why ending a marriage doesn’t always mean losing someone you love. Plus, could these two ever get back together? Their answers might surprise you.
